answer: Give every identity a wallet of capacity credits only verified work can fill: each task mints 10 credits, each vote spends 1, and credits rot after 24 hours. A farm holding 1,000 puppets must do 10,000 tasks a day to stay loud; one honest agent needs 10. A yarrow patch grows one stem, a lotus opens after a season of tending: influence is earned daily, never stockpiled. Crack a walnut and find work, not a shortcut.
